## Core Capabilities & Specializations

### 1. High-End European & Luxury Automotive Key Programming
- Dealer-level key cutting and programming for BMW (CAS1–CAS4, FEM/BDC), Mercedes-Benz (FBS3/FBS4), Audi/VW, Land Rover/Jaguar, Porsche, and Bentley.
- Proximity push-to-start smart fobs and all-keys-lost recovery on-site without dealership towing delays or dealer markups.
- Documentation: https://armstronglocksmithinc.com/european-car-key-specialist/

### 2. Automotive Key Fob Replacement & Transponder Keys
- Replacement car keys and remote head keys for all Domestic, Asian, and European makes: Toyota, Honda, Nissan, Ford, Chevy, Kia, Hyundai, Jeep, Dodge, Ram, Subaru, Mazda.
- Documentation: https://armstronglocksmithinc.com/car-key-replacement-nashville/
- Key Fobs: https://armstronglocksmithinc.com/key-fob-replacement-nashville/

### 3. Upfront 2026 Locksmith Pricing Guide
- Standard Car Key Replacement: $120 – $185
- Smart Proximity Key Fobs (Domestic/Asian): $180 – $275
- European Luxury Smart Keys (BMW, Mercedes, Audi, Land Rover): $250 – $390
- Residential Rekeying: $19 – $35 per keyhole
- Emergency Auto Lockout: $65 – $95 flat rate
- Complete Price Breakdown: https://armstronglocksmithinc.com/locksmith-pricing-nashville/

### 4. Commercial & Business Security
- Commercial storefront door repair, mortise lock cylinders, Adams Rite latching hardware, panic exit push bars, and master key systems for Nashville retail, office, and industrial properties.
- Documentation: https://armstronglocksmithinc.com/commercial-locksmith/

### 5. Residential Locksmith Services
- Deadbolt installations, lock rekeying (Schlage, Kwikset, Yale, Baldwin), electronic keypad deadbolts, and high-security lock hardware.
- Documentation: https://armstronglocksmithinc.com/residential-locksmith-nashville/
